verdict.rationale: The API documents creating organizations and copying settings between them, and requires an organization_id on every request. This implies an accountant can run several separate entities (organizations) side by side. Nothing in the evidence shows consolidated reporting across those organizations, and accountant access and custom reports are described only within a single organization's books. Missing for 10: consolidated financial statements across entities, intercompany transactions/eliminations, multi-entity management documentation beyond API endpoint titles, and independent corroboration.
